description: This source file defines the `PimCsvDataImport` class, a specialized importer for processing CSV data related to employee records in the OrangeHRM system. It handles parsing, validation, and persistence of employee data, utilizing various helper traits and services for functionalities like logging, email/phone validation, and entity fetching.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImport
classes.description: A class responsible for importing employee data from CSV format, with validation and integration with employee services and related entities.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Processes a single employee record represented as an array, validates fields, and saves the employee entity if all validation passes.

methods.name: getDateTimeIfValid
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a DateTime object; returns null if invalid.

methods.name: getNationalityIfValid
methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality entity based on a valid name string.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazy loads or returns the existing instance of NationalityService.

methods.name: getCountryCodeIfValid
methods.description: Returns a valid country code for a given country name string.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Retrieves the CountryService from the dependency container.

methods.name: getProvinceIfValid
methods.description: Returns a valid province code for a given province name string.

methods.name: isValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Validates a phone number string against a ruleset.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Validates an email string against a ruleset.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if the email is unique among employee records.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Checks if the employee ID is unique.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is null or empty.
